eval.description: Anthropic early agentic prompt-injection eval for computer-use (and related workflow) surfaces. Cards describe an expanded set of about 600 scenarios spanning coding platforms, browsers, and user workflows such as email. Headline metric is attack prevention score (higher is better), with and without end-to-end safeguards. Later Shade computer-use ASR results are a different eval.
eval.summary: Tests whether AI agents follow harmful instructions hidden in web pages, emails, or code while they use a computer.
